fields.general_information: The session middleware of the local web API treats a request carrying an empty X-Session header as authenticated. Requests to /api/admin/* then run with installer privileges.
fields.summary: An unauthenticated attacker on the same network can call privileged endpoints of the T100 local web API. Exploitation observed in the wild (synthetic scenario).
fields.title: Actively exploited authentication bypass in Acme T100 local web API
fields.user_action_reduce_impact: Disable the local web API in Settings > Network until the update is installed.
